name: order_percent_discount
description: The order slot holding a PERCENTAGE discount (10% of raw 3.333 = 333.3 -> 333 baisas). Pins the slot's percentage leg — the one order-slot path with its own rounding point in the core (deterministic decimal law; the device rounded the combined sum once on noisy doubles). Subtotal 3.000, VAT 5% = 150, grand 3.150.
